answer: Charge an escalating admission bond: the nth identity created from one funding source in a 30-epoch window must escrow 20 x 2^(n-1) tokens, so a haven of eight clones costs 2,540 tokens. Each bond stays frozen for 60 epochs, and any atlas of shared funding edges is found by replaying public transfers; a flagged sable cluster forfeits half its bond to honest reporters.
